about: Model verdicts on source against tree for hse-l56 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: Paragraph 200 is printed in the ACOP box but the tree marks it as regulation, and paragraph 201 is printed as Guidance but the tree marks it as acop.
findings.evidence: source: "ACOP 18(1)–(2) 200 The location and routing of installation pipework should take into account" / tree: para-200 status "regulation", para-201 status "acop"

findings.problem: The summary box and the regulation text 18(1)–(2) are merged into one text block marked as guidance, so the regulation itself is not marked as regulation.
findings.evidence: source: "Regulation 18(1)–(2) 1) No person shall install any installation pipework" / tree: "Summary of regulation 18 This regulation requires ... 1) No person shall install" status "guidance"

findings.problem: Paragraph 304 is printed in the Guidance 36A box but the tree marks it as regulation.
findings.evidence: source: "Guidance 36A 304 The changes set out in regulation 36A aim to offer more flexibility" / tree: para-304 status "regulation"

findings.problem: The footnote to regulation 36A(4) is filed under the Record keeping heading instead of with the regulation text it belongs to.
findings.evidence: source: "under regulation 36(3) (a) or (b).1" ... "1 Regulation 36A was added by" / tree: heading_path "... > Record keeping > Text"

findings.problem: The text of regulation 40A is printed in the Regulation box but the tree marks it as guidance.
findings.evidence: source: "Regulation 40A (1) The Secretary of State must from time to time –" / tree: regulation-40a-review-text-1 status "guidance"

findings.problem: The footnote to regulation 40A(5) is filed under Regulation 41 instead of Regulation 40A.
findings.evidence: source: "(section 32 of that Act).1" ... "1 Regulation 40A was added by" / tree: heading_path "Regulation 41 Revocation and amendments > Text"

findings.problem: Two words are run together with the year where the footnote markers were dropped.
findings.evidence: source: "Regulations 1996 and the Gas Safety", "Regulations 1996 are hereby revoked" / tree: "1996and", "1996are"

findings.problem: The letters R and M printed inside the Figure 10 diagram are kept as a separate note between Figure 9 and Figure 10, and are missing from the Figure 10 labels.
findings.evidence: source: "R M" (symbols inside the Figure 10 meter box) / tree: note-1 text "R M"

findings.problem: The regulation 2(1) definition of "flue", printed in its own Regulation box, is merged into the end of guidance paragraph 26 under the heading Emergency control and marked as guidance.
findings.evidence: source: Regulation 2(1) "“flue” means a passage for conveying the products of combustion from a gas appliance to the external air" / tree: end of para-26, status guidance

findings.problem: The regulation 2(1) definition of "gas", printed in its own Regulation box, is merged into the end of guidance paragraph 27 under the heading Flues and marked as guidance.
findings.evidence: source: Regulation 2(1) "“gas” means any substance which is or (if it were in a gaseous state) would be gas" / tree: end of para-27, status guidance
